# Solar Ireland

> SEAI-registered solar panel installation company serving the Republic of Ireland. Free surveys, honest quotes, SEAI grant handling (€1,800), typical installation in one day. Contact: cal@solarireland.com, WhatsApp +353 87 395 8424.

Solar Ireland installs residential solar PV and battery storage across all 26 counties. Typical 4 kWp system: €6,000–€8,000 before the €1,800 SEAI grant. Payback is typically 5–8 years. Export tariff €0.21/kWh under the microgeneration support scheme. All work by RECI-registered electricians to NSAI I.S. EN 50559 and ET101 standards.
